---
pagetitle: "GAMER checklist"
page-layout: full
toc: false
resources:
  - /assets/logos/equator_logo.png
  - docx.min.js
---

```{=html}
<style>
  #tp-wrap { --accent:#2a5aa7; --head:#bfbfbf; --box:#eef3fb; --boxline:#9fb6dc; --line:#000;
    font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; color:#111; max-width:1000px; margin:0 auto; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-top { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:.8rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-right { text-align:right; }
  /* Equator logo: hidden on screen, shown only in the saved PDF (print) */
  #tp-wrap .tp-eq { display:none; width:150px; height:auto; margin-left:auto; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-title { font-size:19px; font-weight:bold; line-height:1.3; margin:0 0 .2rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta { font:14px Arial,sans-serif; margin:.4rem 0 .8rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta label { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; width:100%; font-weight:bold; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta input { flex:0 1 50%; min-width:0; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:normal; padding:.35rem .5rem;
    border:1.5px solid var(--boxline); background:var(--box); border-radius:3px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap table { border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; font-size:13px; line-height:1.35; }
  #tp-wrap th, #tp-wrap td { border:1px solid var(--line); padding:5px 6px; vertical-align:middle; text-align:left; }
  #tp-wrap thead th { background:var(--head); font-weight:bold; }
  #tp-wrap td.item { width:5%; text-align:center; }
  #tp-wrap th.rh, #tp-wrap td.rep { width:22%; }
  #tp-wrap th.pgh, #tp-wrap td.pg { width:12%; }
  #tp-wrap td.rep label { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.25rem; margin-right:.6rem; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; }
  #tp-wrap td.rep input { width:16px; height:16px; accent-color:var(--accent); cursor:pointer; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg { padding:3px; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; border:1.5px solid var(--boxline); border-radius:3px; background:var(--box);
    text-align:center; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; padding:6px 2px; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:hover { border-color:var(--accent); }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:#6a7fa3; font-size:12px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:block; font-weight:normal; font-size:11px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-foot { font-size:12.5px; margin:.6rem 0 0; }
  .tp-actions { display:flex; gap:.6rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:1rem 0 1.4rem; }
  .tp-actions button { font:600 15px Arial,sans-serif; padding:.55rem 1.1rem; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer;
    border:2px solid #2a5aa7; background:#2a5aa7; color:#fff; }
  .tp-actions button.alt { background:#fff; color:#2a5aa7; }
  .tp-actions button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f3b800; outline-offset:2px; }
  .tp-note { font:14px Arial,sans-serif; color:#444; margin:0; flex-basis:100%; }

  @media print {
    @page { size:A4 portrait; margin:12mm; }
    body * { visibility:hidden; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap * { visibility:visible; }
    #tp-wrap { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; max-width:none; }
    .tp-actions { display:none !important; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-eq { display:block; }
    #tp-wrap table { font-size:11px; }
    #tp-wrap tr { break-inside:avoid; }
    #tp-wrap thead { display:table-header-group; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-title { font-size:15px; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-foot { font-size:9.5px; }
    #tp-wrap td.pg input { background:none; border:0; }
    #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:transparent; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:none; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap th { -webkit-print-color-adjust:exact; print-color-adjust:exact; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-meta input { border:0; padding:0; background:none; flex:1 1 auto; }
  }
</style>

<div id="tp-wrap">
  <div class="tp-top">
    <div></div>
    <div class="tp-right"><img src="/assets/logos/equator_logo.png" alt="EQUATOR Network" class="tp-eq"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="tp-title">GAMER checklist</div>
  <div class="tp-actions">
    <button type="button" id="tp-pdf">Save as PDF</button>
    <button type="button" id="tp-doc" class="alt">Save as Word</button>
    <button type="button" id="tp-reset" class="alt">Clear all</button>
    <p class="tp-note">For each item, tick <em>Yes</em>, <em>No</em> or <em>N/A</em> and type the page number(s) where it is reported, then save your copy as a PDF or Word (.docx) file.
    “Save as PDF” opens your browser’s print dialog: choose <em>Save as PDF</em> as the destination.
    Your entries stay in this browser until you clear them.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="tp-meta"><label>Manuscript title: <input type="text" id="tp-title" data-key="title" placeholder="Type your manuscript title here"></label></div>
  <table id="tp-table">
    <thead><tr>
      <th>No.</th><th>Item</th><th class="rh">Reported</th>
      <th class="pgh">Page<span class="tp-hint">type page no. in the boxes below</span></th>
    </tr></thead>
    <tbody></tbody>
  </table>
  <ul class="tp-foot"><li>AI, artificial intelligence; GAI, generative artificial intelligence; GAMER, Generative Artificial intelligence tools in MEdical Research; N/A, not applicable.</li></ul>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const ROWS = [
    ["1", "Did you use any GAI tools (such as large language models or large visual models) in any section or step of this manuscript or study?"],
    ["2", "Specify the GAI tool(s) used, their versions and/or release dates and the date(s)/period the tools were used."],
    ["3", "Describe whether a specific prompting technique was used to generate any content of the manuscript or to perform analyses during the study. Please also provide the unedited responses to the prompts."],
    ["4", "If a new GAI tool was developed or fine-tuned based on an existing AI model, report the name and version of the original model."],
    ["5", "Describe the role of GAI tools in all phases of this study where they were used (including manuscript writing)."],
    ["6", "Report the specific section or paragraphs of the manuscript that GAI tools contributed to."],
    ["7", "Describe how the content generated by GAI tools was verified and (when necessary) modified."],
    ["8", "Describe how data privacy and confidentiality were ensured during the use of GAI tools."],
    ["9", "Describe whether and how the use of GAI tools may have influenced the interpretation of results, the study’s overall accuracy, or conclusions."]
  ];
  const OPTS = ["Yes", "No", "N/A"];
  const TITLE = "GAMER checklist";
  const FOOT = ["AI, artificial intelligence; GAI, generative artificial intelligence; GAMER, Generative Artificial intelligence tools in MEdical Research; N/A, not applicable."];

  const STORE = "gamer-checklist-v1";
  const tbody = document.querySelector("#tp-table tbody");
  tbody.innerHTML = ROWS.map(([code, text]) =>
    `<tr><td class="item">${code}</td><td class="txt">${text}</td>` +
    `<td class="rep">` + OPTS.map(o => `<label><input type="checkbox" data-rep="r${code}" data-val="${o}" aria-label="Item ${code}: ${o}">${o}</label>`).join("") + `</td>` +
    `<td class="pg"><input type="text" data-key="p${code}" placeholder="page no." aria-label="Page, item ${code}"></td></tr>`).join("");

  const texts = () => [...document.querySelectorAll("#tp-wrap input[type=text]")];
  const boxes = () => [...document.querySelectorAll("#tp-wrap input[type=checkbox]")];
  const load = () => { try { const d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE) || "{}");
    texts().forEach(i => { if (d[i.dataset.key]) i.value = d[i.dataset.key]; });
    boxes().forEach(b => { if (d[b.dataset.rep] === b.dataset.val) b.checked = true; }); } catch (e) {} };
  const save = () => { try { const d = {};
    texts().forEach(i => { if (i.value) d[i.dataset.key] = i.value; });
    boxes().forEach(b => { if (b.checked) d[b.dataset.rep] = b.dataset.val; });
    localStorage.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify(d)); } catch (e) {} };
  load();
  document.getElementById("tp-wrap").addEventListener("change", e => {
    if (e.target.matches("input[type=checkbox]") && e.target.checked)
      boxes().forEach(b => { if (b !== e.target && b.dataset.rep === e.target.dataset.rep) b.checked = false; });
    save();
  });
  document.getElementById("tp-wrap").addEventListener("input", save);

  document.getElementById("tp-pdf").onclick = () => {
    const old = document.title;
    document.title = "GAMER checklist";
    window.print();
    document.title = old;
  };

  document.getElementById("tp-reset").onclick = () => {
    if (confirm("Clear all answers, page numbers and the manuscript title?")) {
      texts().forEach(i => i.value = ""); boxes().forEach(b => b.checked = false); save(); }
  };

  // ---- Word (.docx) export -------------------------------------------------
  function buildDocx(D, ROWS, vals, title, foot, eqLogo) {
    const F = "Arial", SZ = 18, W = [650, 6016, 2400, 1400], TOTAL = W.reduce((a, b) => a + b);
    const ln = { style: D.BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 6, color: "000000" };
    const run = (text, o = {}) => new D.TextRun({ text, font: o.font || F, size: o.size || SZ, bold: o.bold });
    const cell = (i, children, o = {}) => new D.TableCell({
      width: { size: W[i], type: D.WidthType.DXA }, verticalAlign: D.VerticalAlign.CENTER,
      shading: o.fill ? { type: D.ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: o.fill, color: "auto" } : undefined,
      margins: { top: 60, bottom: 60, left: 90, right: 90 }, borders: { top: ln, bottom: ln, left: ln, right: ln },
      children: [new D.Paragraph({ alignment: o.center ? D.AlignmentType.CENTER : D.AlignmentType.LEFT, children })]
    });
    const hd = { fill: "BFBFBF" };
    const head = new D.TableRow({ tableHeader: true, cantSplit: true, children: [
      cell(0, [run("No.", { bold: true })], { ...hd, center: true }), cell(1, [run("Item", { bold: true })], hd),
      cell(2, [run("Reported", { bold: true })], hd), cell(3, [run("Page", { bold: true })], hd)] });
    const body = ROWS.map(([code, text]) => {
      const sel = vals["r" + code];
      const rep = OPTS.flatMap((o, i) => [
        run((sel === o ? "\u2612" : "\u2610"), { font: "Segoe UI Symbol" }), run(" " + o + (i < OPTS.length - 1 ? "   " : ""))]);
      return new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [
        cell(0, [run(code)], { center: true }), cell(1, [run(text)]), cell(2, rep),
        cell(3, [run(vals["p" + code] || "")], { center: true })] });
    });
    const para = (children, o = {}) => new D.Paragraph({ spacing: { after: 80 }, ...o, children });
    const footer = new D.Footer({ children: [new D.Paragraph({ alignment: D.AlignmentType.CENTER,
      children: [new D.TextRun({ children: ["Page ", D.PageNumber.CURRENT, " of ", D.PageNumber.TOTAL_PAGES], font: F, size: 18 })] })] });
    const none = { style: D.BorderStyle.NONE, size: 0, color: "FFFFFF" };
    const noBorders = { top: none, bottom: none, left: none, right: none };
    const HW = [6200, 4266];
    const hcell = (i, children) => new D.TableCell({
      width: { size: HW[i], type: D.WidthType.DXA }, borders: noBorders,
      verticalAlign: D.VerticalAlign.CENTER, margins: { top: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0 }, children });
    const empty = () => [para([], { spacing: { after: 0 } })];
    const right = eqLogo
      ? [para([new D.ImageRun({ data: eqLogo, type: "png", transformation: { width: 140, height: Math.round(140 * 90 / 310) } })], { alignment: D.AlignmentType.RIGHT, spacing: { after: 0 } })]
      : empty();
    const topTable = new D.Table({ width: { size: HW[0] + HW[1], type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: HW, borders: { ...noBorders, insideHorizontal: none, insideVertical: none },
      rows: [new D.TableRow({ children: [hcell(0, empty()), hcell(1, right)] })] });
    return new D.Document({
      title: "GAMER checklist", creator: "GAMER checklist",
      sections: [{
        footers: { default: footer },
        properties: { page: { size: { width: 11906, height: 16838 }, margin: { top: 720, bottom: 800, left: 720, right: 720 } } },
        children: [
          topTable, para([], { spacing: { after: 60 } }),
          para([run(title, { bold: true, size: 26 })], { spacing: { after: 120 } }),
          para([run("Manuscript title: ", { bold: true, size: 20 }), run(vals.title || "", { size: 20 })], { spacing: { after: 140 } }),
          new D.Table({ width: { size: TOTAL, type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: W, rows: [head, ...body] }),
          ...foot.map(t => para([run("\u2022 " + t, { size: 16, bold: true })], { spacing: { before: 140 } }))]
      }]
    });
  }

  const loadDocx = () => window.docx ? Promise.resolve() : new Promise((res, rej) => {
    const el = document.createElement("script");
    el.src = new URL("docx.min.js", document.baseURI).href;
    el.onload = res; el.onerror = () => rej(new Error("Could not load docx.min.js"));
    document.head.appendChild(el);
  });

  document.getElementById("tp-doc").onclick = async () => {
    const btn = document.getElementById("tp-doc"), label = btn.textContent;
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Preparing…";
    try {
      await loadDocx();
      let eqLogo = null;
      try { eqLogo = new Uint8Array(await (await fetch(new URL("/assets/logos/equator_logo.png", document.baseURI))).arrayBuffer()); } catch (e) {}
      const vals = {};
      texts().forEach(i => vals[i.dataset.key] = i.value);
      boxes().forEach(b => { if (b.checked) vals[b.dataset.rep] = b.dataset.val; });
      const blob = await window.docx.Packer.toBlob(buildDocx(window.docx, ROWS, vals, TITLE, FOOT, eqLogo));
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([blob], { type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" }));
      a.download = "GAMER-checklist.docx";
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 2000);
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Sorry, the Word file could not be created. " + e.message);
    } finally { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = label; }
  };
})();
</script>
```
